# Message Status

MessageStatus is a compact but unambiguous projection of transport state.

## Geometry

Sent uses a single check; Delivered uses a compact neutral double check; Read keeps the same geometry and adds the semantic read color.

## Accessibility

Screen-reader names distinguish sent, delivered, read, and failed rather than announcing a generic icon.

## Components

[MessageStatus](/en/components/message-status) and [MessageMeta](/en/components/message-meta) share the projection.
